Extended / Pro-code

Work beyond the form.

Run business logic on the Power Pages server, query Dataverse through a server operation, and call a solution-aware Power Automate flow.

Portal session→Web role→Server operation or cloud flow→Returned result

01 / Server-side calculation

Service estimate

Price, discount and tax are calculated on the server. Change the inputs and inspect the returned total.

Submit an estimate to receive the server result.

POST /_api/serverlogics/paqvilo-estimate

02 / Server-side data

Account overview

Retrieve a bounded account summary from Dataverse through a secured server operation.

Read the overview to see the server response.

GET /_api/serverlogics/paqvilo-account-summary

03 / Power Automate

Location acknowledgement

Send a location to the Example Location flow and receive its response. The flow runs without email or external side effects.

Run the flow to see its actual returned value.

Power Pages trigger · solution-aware flow · authenticated web role

04 / Liquid invocation

Before the browser loads

Liquid invokes the server operation while this page renders. The result below is part of the server-generated response.

{% assign estimateInput = '{"units":3,"price":120,"discount":10,"tax":20}' %}{% serverlogic name: 'paqvilo-estimate', operation: 'calculate', input: estimateInput, output: renderedEstimate %}
{% if renderedEstimate.success %}{{ renderedEstimate.raw_result | escape }}{% else %}Server operation returned HTTP {{ renderedEstimate.status_code }}.{% endif %}

The initial estimate is 3 × 120, with 10% discount and 20% tax. Expected total: 388.80.
